lawRefs: Tenn. Code Ann. Title 67, ch. 2 (Hall income tax on interest and dividends; repealed for tax periods beginning on or after Jan 1 2021)
header.notes: sha256 is of the canonical JSON body (JSON.stringify of the file without `header`). Values hand-transcribed; sha256 is of the canonical body. Tennessee has no tax on wages; its Hall income tax on interest and dividends "was repealed for tax periods that begin on January 1, 2021, or later" (Tennessee DOR). Cross-checked against Tax Foundation, "State Individual Income Tax Rates and Brackets, 2026" (data as of Jan 1 2026, updated Feb 11 2026).
